title: Boyhood: riding the trucks with Jack Carey
summary: As a boy he loved hearing High Society and Chinatown and rode trucks with Jack Carey's band, with Chris Kelly and a drummer called Johnny.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: When I was a kid, I used to love to hear High Society play by Papa Salstein and Kiddo. I remember, and I remember riding a lot of times on the trucks with Jack Carey. He was one of the leading musicians in New Orleans at the time. I used to love to hear them play Chinatown. And I would get on the truck, ride. Do you remember who else was with Jack Carey? Chris Kelly was one of the musicians. And I had a drummer at the time. I don't know his real name, but they used to call him Johnny.
He's still around. He's still around.
He was a very wonderful little drummer at the time. And there's a lot of good musicians. I enjoyed the music. They was playing a lot of swinging jazz music, just like they do in the day.
